purpose: Training corpus: really easy everyday problems on an Ubuntu laptop that an expert human can fix in 30 seconds or less with a single command or quick setting change. Every case is fully resolvable by the agent on its own (expected = resolve).

test_cases.prompt: Wi-Fi keeps disconnecting every few minutes
test_cases.cause: Wi-Fi power saving lets the adapter go to sleep under light traffic.
solution_steps: nmcli networking off; nmcli networking on
Persist: sudo sed -i 's/wifi.powersave = 3/wifi.powersave = 2/' /etc/NetworkManager/conf.d/default-wifi-powersave-on.conf && sudo systemctl restart NetworkManager

test_cases.prompt: Wi-Fi is connected but pages will not load, no internet
test_cases.cause: Stale DNS cache or the systemd-resolved service is stuck.

test_cases.prompt: No Wi-Fi networks are listed at all
test_cases.cause: The Wi-Fi radio is soft-blocked (rfkill) or NetworkManager is stuck.
solution_steps: sudo rfkill unblock wifi; sudo systemctl restart NetworkManager
test_cases.description: Unblock the radio and restart NM

test_cases.prompt: Temporary failure in name resolution when opening websites
test_cases.cause: The DNS resolver (systemd-resolved) is down or its cache is corrupted.

test_cases.prompt: Bluetooth is stuck and will not turn on
test_cases.cause: The Bluetooth daemon (bluetoothd) hung or the adapter is blocked.

test_cases.prompt: There is no sound at all after an update
test_cases.cause: The audio server (PulseAudio/PipeWire) crashed or is stuck.

test_cases.prompt: No sound through headphones, it still plays on the speakers
test_cases.cause: The wrong audio output device is selected.
solution_steps: Select the headphones as the output device
test_cases.description: Pick the correct output in pavucontrol

test_cases.prompt: My microphone does not pick up my voice
test_cases.cause: Wrong input device selected or the microphone input is muted.
solution_steps: Select the mic and uncheck mute
test_cases.description: Set the right input in pavucontrol

test_cases.prompt: Sound is muted and the volume icon does nothing
test_cases.cause: The master output channel is muted.

test_cases.prompt: The clock shows the wrong time
test_cases.cause: NTP synchronization is disabled or the time-sync service is stuck.
solution_steps: sudo systemctl restart systemd-timesyncd; timedatectl status

test_cases.prompt: apt update fails with 'Release file is not yet valid'
test_cases.cause: The system clock is out of sync with the repository metadata (clock ahead/behind).
solution_steps: sudo timedatectl set-ntp true; sudo systemctl restart systemd-timesyncd

test_cases.prompt: The clock shows the wrong timezone
test_cases.cause: The system timezone is set incorrectly.

test_cases.prompt: E: dpkg was interrupted, you must run sudo dpkg --configure -a
test_cases.cause: A previous package install/upgrade was interrupted, leaving packages half-configured.

test_cases.prompt: apt says 'Unable to lock the administration directory /var/lib/dpkg/'
test_cases.cause: Another apt/dpkg process (Update Manager, unattended-upgrades) holds the lock.
solution_steps: If the process is stuck, run: sudo killall apt apt-get; sudo dpkg --configure -a

test_cases.prompt: I cannot install a package, dependency errors
test_cases.cause: Broken/unmet package dependencies after a partial install.

test_cases.prompt: E: Unable to locate package / command not found when installing
test_cases.cause: Stale package lists or the package simply is not installed yet.

test_cases.prompt: Software Center / apt is broken after a failed upgrade
test_cases.cause: Packages left in a half-installed state after an interrupted upgrade.
solution_steps: sudo apt -f install; sudo apt update && sudo apt upgrade

test_cases.prompt: The top bar and desktop are frozen, clicks do nothing
test_cases.cause: GNOME Shell hung.

test_cases.prompt: The whole desktop is frozen and nothing responds
test_cases.cause: The display/session manager is hung and the shell cannot restart itself.
solution_steps: Press Ctrl+Alt+F2, log in, run: sudo systemctl restart gdm
Press Ctrl+Alt+F1 to switch back to the GUI

test_cases.prompt: An application is frozen and will not close
test_cases.cause: The application process is hung.

test_cases.prompt: Tap to click on the touchpad does not work
test_cases.cause: Tap-to-click is disabled in the desktop settings.

test_cases.prompt: Touchpad stopped working after the laptop woke from sleep
test_cases.cause: The psmouse input module is stuck after suspend/resume.
solution_steps: sudo modprobe -r psmouse && sudo modprobe psmouse

test_cases.prompt: My keyboard types the wrong letters
test_cases.cause: The active keyboard layout is switched to another language.

test_cases.prompt: External monitor is not detected
test_cases.cause: The display configuration was not refreshed after plugging in the monitor.
solution_steps: Re-plug the cable if it still shows nothing

test_cases.prompt: The screen resolution is wrong or everything looks blurry
test_cases.cause: The display is running at the wrong resolution.

test_cases.prompt: Brightness keys do not change the screen brightness
test_cases.cause: The backlight controls are managed by the driver; key hotkeys are not bound.
test_cases.description: Set brightness from the command line

test_cases.prompt: The disk is almost full and updates will not install
test_cases.cause: Apt cache and journald logs are consuming the remaining space.
test_cases.description: Free space by cleaning caches and logs

test_cases.prompt: Read-only file system, cannot write or save anything
test_cases.cause: The filesystem was mounted read-only after an unclean shutdown.

test_cases.prompt: Print jobs are stuck in the queue and nothing prints
test_cases.cause: The CUPS print service is backlogged or hung.
test_cases.description: Clear the queue and restart CUPS

test_cases.prompt: USB stick or external drive is not showing up
test_cases.cause: The device is detected but not auto-mounted, or needs mounting.
